summary: Iteration 105 regression: verified helper-function refactors in routes_admin.py (_public_base_url, _notify_result_whatsapp, _delivery_links), routes_public.py (_photo_background_fallback), and zami_status.py (_public_base_url) did not regress touched endpoints, and that the stale https://dubaivizeonline.com URL fallback is gone from all production backend modules. Created new pytest file with 18 tests covering: general regression (visa-types, content/site, bundles?visa_days=30 with pack_family, contact, admin apps/orders lists), application lifecycle (create + track + PATCH status reviewing with note+notify=true + PATCH status approved exercising WhatsApp simulate-mode swallow), order delivery (400 when no files, single-file, both-files with 2 signed /api/files/ links + PUBLIC_BASE_URL host + no stale domain), photo/check (happy path, PDF early return, 404 nonexistent), and stale-domain grep across production modules. 18/18 passed. Backend logs contain zero 500s / tracebacks during the run (only the expected 'photo ai failed' logged.error for the dummy JPG which is the designed fallback branch).
critical_code_review_comments: routes_admin.py::admin_deliver_order calls _resolve_origin(payload.get('origin_url'), None) with request=None, so the origin falls back to os.environ.get('PUBLIC_SITE_URL'). Consider also honoring PUBLIC_BASE_URL to align with the new _public_base_url() helper (currently PUBLIC_SITE_URL and PUBLIC_BASE_URL are both set to the same value in .env, so no observable bug, but the two helpers diverge in fallback precedence).
routes_admin.py is 1311 lines; still exceeds the 700-line guideline. Owner has explicitly deferred further splitting due to risk - documented and acknowledged.
The email 'sent' status only means Resend accepted the API call - admin mailbox info@dubaivizehatti.com is currently hard-bouncing (known open issue, not a regression).
test_credentials: Admin token via /app/backend/admin_test_token.py (JWT signed with JWT_SECRET). ADMIN_LOGIN_EMAIL=info@dubaivizeonline.com.
seed_data_creation: Test data prefixed TEST_ / delivered@resend.dev: 1 application, 2 orders, ~6 uploads, 1 contact message. Left in DB for audit; naming allows cleanup via TEST_ prefix.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Refactor verified. New test file /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_105_refactor_regression.py is 18 tests, all green, reusable as regression suite. Note the /api/admin/emails list endpoint strips the html field (has_preview only); use /api/admin/emails/{id} to inspect full body. Signed file links use ?t=<token> not ?token=. _resolve_origin(None-request) uses PUBLIC_SITE_URL fallback while _public_base_url() uses PUBLIC_BASE_URL - both currently point to the same preview URL.
rca of the issue: N/A - no regressions found. Initial test failure was in the test script itself (wrong outbox field name and token query param); corrected and all pass.
